scope: Rahlfs–Hanhart 2006 remains the user-authorized provisional base. Focused checks of the publisher’s Greek running text are recorded by chapter. This is an English editorial revision, not a complete critical-text or apparatus verification. Göttingen, full apparatus, independent Greek and human read-aloud reviews remain pending.
historical_records: Existing index and reference records were consulted as historical reference, not proof of fresh complete Greek verification.

chapters.focus: Ordinary address to the prophet and third-person verbs are modernized; Thou and hast/wilt remain in the angel’s direct address to God at 1:12. Attributive My ordinances replaces Mine ordinances. Listening attentively and the ordering of the command clause improve flow, while return, great anger and jealousy repetitions, My Spirit, your rather than our at 1:6, two shaded mountains, four horse colors, speaking within me and this seventieth year remain. Has sent out makes the completed commission explicit at 1:10.

chapters.focus: Ordinary address uses you and verbs use says/has; has sent me preserves the completed commission. Josiah, Zephaniah and Josedek retain the site’s inherited names.
